description: This file defines the HomeActivity class for an Android weather application. It manages UI interactions, location permissions, weather data requests, updates the user interface with weather information, and handles app updates within the app lifecycle.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity class that handles the weather data retrieval, UI updates, location permissions, app updates, and user interactions for the weather app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets UI, checks for updates, sets listeners, and fetches weather data.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from speech recognition activity.

methods.name: setNavigationBarColor
methods.description: Sets the color of the navigation bar if API level permits.

methods.name: setUpDaysRecyclerView
methods.description: Initializes the RecyclerView for displaying weather forecast days.

methods.name: listeners
methods.description: Sets up user interaction listeners for UI components.

methods.name: setRefreshLayoutColor
methods.description: Sets color schemes for the refresh layout.

methods.name: searchCity
methods.description: Searches weather info for a specified city.

methods.name: getDataUsingNetwork
methods.description: Fetches current location and weather data from network.

methods.name: setLatitudeLongitudeUsingCity
methods.description: Fetches latitude and longitude for a given city from server.

methods.name: getTodayWeatherInfo
methods.description: Requests weather data for current day from API and updates UI.

methods.name: updateUI
methods.description: Populates UI components with the latest weather data.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates day to local language format.

methods.name: hideMainLayout
methods.description: Shows the loading indicator and hides main content.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks internet connectivity and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Performs connectivity check on activity resume.

methods.name: checkUpdate
methods.description: Checks for application update and initiates immediate update if available.
